# Isolated, earned chapter 9.2 terminal fixture

This page is a source-only, disposable-guest test entry. Production index, art,
CSS, controller, models, account/rewards/cloud scripts and accepted archive
format remain unchanged. The approved GitHub CI driver fulfills only pinned
first-party resources at a synthetic HTTPS origin; it creates no listener and
aborts external HTTP and WebSocket requests.

## What is actually played

The unchanged `field-missions.js` creates a new chapter 9, phase 2, stage 4 gate
with seed 16,569. The native robot reads the model/layout and presses the real
boost/wait/send-ship controls, then the real Continue Operation button. No won
checkpoint is assigned, no completion callback is directly invoked, and browser
or model time is never replaced or frozen. These are model-informed robot inputs,
not human-play evidence.

All earlier chapter tasks, prior finale phases, the prepared legacy operations
record, chapter decisions, precision and 2,100 demo points are declared synthetic
prerequisites. The fixture does not prove a whole earned campaign. Prior phase
seconds are a declared baseline, not measured native playtime. Pinned precision
is presented to the existing legacy reader through a deterministic synthetic
performance-only history; it is not an assertion that prior history was played.

## Authority and recovery

A dedicated bootstrap reads and validates adoption, context, earned phase and
canonical completion before evaluating either selected legacy controller. Empty
storage offers an explicit Start action. A known started session, incomplete
adoption or unreadable archive blocks rather than re-importing native mirrors or
silently reseeding. Ordinary in-page checkpoint saves are volatile observations;
before the immutable earned phase is sealed, reload may return to the committed
start. A sealed phase can finish the new owned canonical command after reload.

Result and guest balance read the canonical record. Continue opens unchanged
`MKTYLegacy.epilogue` with a pure home-navigation callback. No original finale
callback, `awardLifePoints`, `MKTYRewards.completeLife` or original mission opener
is loaded or called. Old native storage is neither imported nor modified by the
owned facade; hostile mirror updates, overlay flush and clearing are tested only
on this disposable origin. Unrelated pending-queue sentinel bytes are preserved.

## Qualification

Native evidence must come from the exact approved CI commit. Local syntax/source
checks are not native acceptance. Transactions are atomic local browser state;
strict durability is a hint, not power-loss/eviction/site-deletion survival.
No authenticated rewards, server policy, live migration, mixed-release authority,
anti-cheat, whole-game ownership, physical-device support or JS heap/RSS bound is
claimed. Representation budgets are distinct from bounded test/report copies.

The facade's derived legacy/source/precision strings are runtime-owned, admitted
within an 8 KiB share of the existing metadata reservation. Constructing the
precision graph and its serialization uses the existing 64 KiB atomic workspace;
old cache strings are dropped first. Story/result strings are borrowed from the
owner's charged lease and are cleared before owner replacement. Every H.facts()
structuredClone is a bounded test observation only, never a runtime read source
or an input to canonical reconstruction.

Lost-ack tests hold native terminal event delivery to the adapter. The adapter's
real watchdog must expire and the actual native transaction must complete before
that watchdog callback is released. This test instrumentation does not replace
Date, controller timers, model seconds or earned inputs.
